missat: BOF_18_1 opens on `Passar den min tank?` — a question cannot be true or false (three-question test, Q2), and the table marks it ✅ falsifiable. The Termoskydd and MC-Kapell rounds rewrote exactly this hook into a measurement; this one did not.
`2 minuter` (CS_9_H1, PD_11_H1, RI_1_H1) is not on the page — the page says `stäng dragkedjan` with no time. Film it and time it, or write [TID] as the Termoskydd PD_8_H1 brief does.
CS_9_H1's hypothesis ("the price angle is the cheapest purchase per krona, a shorter cut beats the long cut") names no numbers — cite CPA and purchases against break-even.
No Variables line on any brief; 5 of 9 concepts have no source named and are not marked as a guess; no COPY CARD.
The three-question table is ✅✅❌ on every line including the question hook and `4,7 av 5` — filled in, not run.
This product has no memory in the repo (no dna.md / feedback.md) — the Feedback row in the hub is its memory.
regler: Hooks are declaratives, never questions: lead with the measurement or the outcome (`120 × 100 × 116 cm. Passar en standard 1000 L IBC-tank.`) — a question cannot be falsified and fails the test.
Every timing claim is filmed and timed: the page never says `2 minuter` — write [TID] and let the take set the number, or drop the time.

Add a Variables line (angle · hook · format · proof · offer · visual · text · speaker) to every brief and cite the parent's CPA and purchases against break-even in the Why — "cheapest purchase per krona" needs the numbers.
